t: What Bridge Inspection Database Is All About
title: What Bridge Inspection Database Is All About
description: Bridge inspection is scheduled vigilance: NBIS mandates biennial inspections; ratings 0-9 (9 excellent, 4 poor, ≤3 serious); fracture-critical members get arms-length looks. The I-35W collapse (2007, 13 dead) was a gusset plate undersized from design — inspection can't catch design errors, but catches deterioration. Load postings protect the marginal; scour monitoring watches the water. This database is the complete bridge inspection: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
